name: INTERCEPTED
description:
An email was intercepted from a compromised web server.
Investigators believe criminals were using the server to exchange secret messages. The message body appears vague and contains no obvious PGP-encrypted content.

Something else may be carrying the information.
The email itself may contain more than what is immediately visible.

🎯 Mission

Analyze the intercepted email and uncover the hidden message.
Examine the email's metadata and identify the information concealed within it.
You are looking for a traditional flag{}.

🛠️ Suggested Tools
Email header analyzer
grep
strings
Text editor
Hex editor
Mail/EML analysis tools

🚩 Flag Format

Submit the recovered flag using the traditional format:
pcgCTF{theflaghere}
